freimodus.notiz: Direct call first: generation runs in the browser straight against the provider API (own key, this session only). Local proxy (scripts/proxy.mjs, localhost only) is only a fallback for network/CORS issues — without a key it uses its server key.
freimodus.eigenerKey: Own API key (for the selected provider)
freimodus.keyMerken: Remember key for this session (session storage)
freimodus.begriffZuKurz: Please enter a free term (at least 2 characters).

bibliothek.notiz: Curated 10-model library = reference (read-only). Session entries: view, revise, delete, export.
bibliothek.leer: Library empty — adopt a curated model or import a .js file.
bibliothek.sitzungMerken: Remember library permanently in browser (localStorage, user choice)
bibliothek.sitzungMerkt: Session will be remembered in this tab.
bibliothek.inModify: “{id}” loaded into the revise panel — describe the change and start.

modellExport.keinSvg: No SVG available for this view.

fallback.keinWebgl2: F3: WebGL2 missing. 2D fallback view with parts list and dimensions. Status: auto-checked with limitations.
fallback.darstellung: F3 ({level}): rendering error. 2D fallback view active. Status: auto-checked with limitations.

fehler.E-GEN-400: The request was invalid. Check the term and try again.
fehler.E-GEN-401: The API key was rejected (401). Check the key for typos.
fehler.E-GEN-402: Credit exhausted (402). Use the prepared library.
fehler.E-GEN-403: No permission for this model (403). Check the key rights.
fehler.E-GEN-404: Model not found (404). The model ID is outdated — use the library.
fehler.E-GEN-413: The request is too large (413). Shorten the term.
fehler.E-GEN-429: Rate limit reached (429). Please wait a minute and try again.
fehler.E-GEN-5XX: The generation service is overloaded. Try again later or use the library.
fehler.E-GEN-504: Generation timed out (504). Shorten the term and try again.
fehler.E-GEN-PARSE: The response contained no valid model. Try again or use the library.
fehler.E-GEN-CONFIG: Please enter the proxy URL and a valid key.
fehler.E-GEN-OFFLINE: No generation proxy configured. The prepared library is available.
fehler.E-GEN-DIREKT: Direct call blocked (network/CORS) and no proxy fallback configured. Enter a proxy URL or use the library.

diagnose.fehler: Copy failed — please select the text manually.

modify.notiz: Change the current model via LLM: describe the change, have it checked, the result reloads automatically.
modify.promptPlatzhalter: e.g. red housing, twice as large
modify.promptZuKurz: Please enter a change request (at least 2 characters).
modify.reserve: Iteration 3 manual only — no automatic repair ({id}).
modify.keineHistorie: No versions yet — V1 appears here after the first revision.

onboarding.text: Welcome! Pick a lab on the left; in free mode generate directly with your own key (session only) — no proxy needed.

fuss.notiz: Lab player · generation directly in the browser (session-only key) or via local proxy fallback · history stays local.
